es: Contar una respuesta de entrevista con situación, acción, resultado y lección, controlando pasado simple, pasado perfecto y presente perfecto, y cerrar con una enseñanza que revele criterio propio.

vocabulary.es: lección aprendida a base de esfuerzo

teaching.en: Last spring, I was in charge of the school recycling project, which had been struggling since the previous autumn.
teaching.es: La primavera pasada estaba a cargo del proyecto de reciclaje del colegio, que llevaba en dificultades desde el otoño anterior.
teaching.explanationEs: Situación: el pasado simple (was) sitúa la historia; in charge of indica tu papel.

project, which had been struggling since the previous autumn.

teaching.en: When I arrived, the bins were overflowing because nobody had collected the paper for a week, and most students had stopped caring.
teaching.es: Cuando llegué, los contenedores rebosaban porque nadie había recogido el papel en una semana y la mayoría de los estudiantes había dejado de interesarse.
teaching.explanationEs: Pasado perfecto (had + participio) para lo ocurrido antes del momento que cuentas.

teaching.en: I decided to take the initiative: I drew up a weekly rota and asked each class to choose a captain.
teaching.es: Decidí tomar la iniciativa: elaboré un turno semanal y pedí a cada clase que eligiera un capitán.
teaching.explanationEs: Acción: verbos en pasado simple en orden cronológico.

weekly rota and asked each class to choose a captain.
teaching.audioText: I decided to take the initiative: I drew up a weekly rota and asked each class to choose a captain.

teaching.en: As a result, our recycling rate has doubled since then, and teachers have begun to copy the same rota elsewhere.
teaching.es: Como resultado, nuestra tasa de reciclaje se ha duplicado desde entonces y los profesores han empezado a copiar el mismo turno en otros sitios.
teaching.explanationEs: Presente perfecto para un efecto que sigue vigente hoy; since then marca el punto de partida.

and teachers have begun to copy the same rota elsewhere.

teaching.en: The experience taught me that people will take responsibility for a task only when it clearly belongs to them.
teaching.es: La experiencia me enseñó que la gente solo asume la responsabilidad de una tarea cuando claramente le pertenece.
teaching.explanationEs: Lección aprendida: taught me that + idea general, en presente.

a task only when it clearly belongs to them.

teaching.en: It was also a hard-won lesson about listening first: the project began to turn around only once each captain felt heard.
teaching.es: También fue una lección aprendida a base de esfuerzo sobre escuchar primero: el proyecto empezó a remontar solo cuando cada capitán se sintió escuchado.
teaching.explanationEs: Turn around = reconducir algo que iba mal; el adjetivo hard-won añade matiz a lesson.

prompt.es: Completa: «Para entonces, nadie había recogido el papel en casi una semana.»

feedback.es: Nadie había recogido el papel antes de que ella llegara: hecho anterior, pasado perfecto con had.

hint.es: Es un hecho anterior a otro momento del pasado: necesitas el auxiliar del pasado perfecto.

origin.text: The bins were overflowing when I took over the project. By then, nobody ___ collected the paper for almost a week.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Decidí tomar la iniciativa y elaboré un turno semanal.»

answer.text: I decided to take the initiative and drew up a weekly rota

feedback.es: Las dos acciones van en pasado simple y en orden: decided… and drew up…

hint.es: Empieza por el sujeto y el verbo decided; después viene to take the initiative.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase cuenta con el tiempo correcto un efecto que sigue vigente hoy?

choices.text: Since then, the club gained forty more members.
Since then, the club has gained forty more members.
Since then, the club was gaining forty more members.

feedback.es: Since then conecta un momento pasado con hoy y pide presente perfecto: has gained.

hint.es: Since then enlaza un momento pasado con hoy.

origin.text: Two years ago the club had only ten members and nobody came to the meetings. The new captain changed the routine, and the figures have looked very different ever since.

prompt.es: Completa: «estaba a cargo del huerto» y «la mayoría ya se había marchado».

feedback.es: La situación va en pasado simple (was) y el hecho anterior en pasado perfecto (had already left).

sentences: In the spring of 2024, I ___ in charge of the garden project.
By the time I arrived, most volunteers ___ already left.

prompt.es: Escucha el relato y elige qué lección saca la hablante.

choices.text: That posters are useful only in the first week of a campaign.
That every class should have its own captain for every task.
That asking people directly works better than advertising to them.

feedback.es: Su lección está en el final: desde entonces empieza por las personas, no por los carteles, porque pedir ayuda directamente funciona mejor que anunciarse.

origin.audio: Two years ago, I organised a food drive at school. At first, nobody had signed up, so I visited every class and asked each one to choose a captain. As a result, we collected three hundred bags of food in a week. Since then, I have always started with people, not posters, because a poster asks for attention, while a person offers help.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase cierra mejor la respuesta con una lección aprendida?

choices.text: That experience taught me that a clear plan matters more than enthusiasm.
That experience had started before the new manager arrived at the club.
That experience has continued for two years without any real change.

feedback.es: «Taught me that…» formula la lección; las otras dos solo aportan información de tiempo, no una enseñanza.

origin.text: An applicant has just told the story of a failed fundraiser and wants to close with one sentence that states clearly what she learned from it.

prompt.es: Escribe tu respuesta: situación, acción, resultado y lección.

answer.text: Two years ago, I was in charge of the school charity concert, which was already in trouble when I took it over. Nobody had booked the hall, the posters had not been printed, and several students had lost interest. I decided to take the initiative. First, I drew up a simple checklist and asked each class to choose a captain who would report to me every Friday. Then I phoned the music teacher, who found us a hall within two days. As a result, we sold every ticket in a week, and the concert has become a yearly tradition since then. The school has raised twice as much money as before. The experience taught me that a clear plan gives people confidence. It was also a hard-won lesson about asking for help early, because the project only began to turn around once I stopped trying to do everything myself. Since then, I have used the same approach in every team I have joined.
accepted: Two years ago, I was in charge of the school charity concert, which was already in trouble when I took it over. Nobody had booked the hall, the posters had not been printed, and several students had lost interest. I decided to take the initiative. First, I drew up a simple checklist and asked each class to choose a captain who would report to me every Friday. Then I phoned the music teacher, who found us a hall within two days. As a result, we sold every ticket in a week, and the concert has become a yearly tradition since then. The school has raised twice as much money as before. The experience taught me that a clear plan gives people confidence. It was also a hard-won lesson about asking for help early, because the project only began to turn around once I stopped trying to do everything myself. Since then, I have used the same approach in every team I have joined.

Last year, I was in charge of the school garden. When I joined, nobody had watered the plants for a month, and most of the volunteers had already stopped coming. I decided to start again with a clear plan. I made a watering rota, I asked each class to choose a captain and I called the science teacher to ask for help. Within a week, the garden looked alive again. As a result, it has produced vegetables every summer since then, and the canteen has used them in its menu. The experience taught me that people help when they know exactly what they have to do. I also learned that asking for support early saves a lot of time. Today I use the same method whenever I start a new project.

feedback.es: Una respuesta completa sitúa la historia, recuerda un hecho anterior, cuenta tu acción, da un resultado que sigue vigente y cierra con una lección.

origin.text: En una entrevista para un programa de liderazgo te piden: «Cuéntame una ocasión en que lideraste un proyecto que iba mal». Escribe 210–270 palabras: situación y acción en pasado, un hecho anterior con pasado perfecto, un resultado vigente con presente perfecto y la lección aprendida.

prompt.es: Escucha el relato y elige qué da a entender su última respuesta sobre el liderazgo.

choices.text: That a leader's first task is to reconcile the groups before assigning anything.
That a leader should personally take charge of every group's work.
That leaders earn respect mainly through the results of their campaigns.
That a leader's first task is to clarify who is responsible for what.

feedback.es: Al decir que lo primero es que todos sepan quién responde de qué, sugiere que liderar es dejar claras las responsabilidades, no reconciliar ni controlarlo todo.

origin.audio: During a scholarship interview, a candidate was asked about a time when she had led a team. She began with the situation: last summer, she was in charge of a clean-up campaign on the beach, and by the time she arrived, the volunteers had already split into two groups that refused to work together. She listened to both, drew up a shared plan and gave each group its own captain. The campaign has collected more rubbish every year since then. Asked what she had learned, she answered that a leader's first job is to make sure everyone knows who is responsible for what.

prompt.es: ¿Qué correcciones necesita este fragmento de una respuesta de entrevista?

choices.text: Lost should be had lost, and doubled should be has doubled.
Lost should be has lost, and doubled should be had doubled.
Only doubled should change, to has doubled; lost is correct here.
Only lost should change, to had lost; doubled is correct here.

feedback.es: El descenso de socios ocurrió antes de que ella fuera tesorera (had lost), y el efecto llega hasta hoy con since then (has doubled).

origin.text: By the time I became treasurer, the club lost most of its members. I visited every former member, listened to their complaints and changed the fees. Since then, membership doubled, and the accounts have been in profit every year.

prompt.es: Completa: «Fue una lección difícil pero valiosa sobre pedir ayuda a tiempo.»

feedback.es: Hard-won lesson es la colocación para una enseñanza que costó esfuerzo o fracaso.

origin.text: We lost the final by a single point, and I blamed myself for months. Looking back, it was a hard-won ___ about asking for help early.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Desde entonces, hemos tomado la iniciativa en cada proyecto.»

answer.text: Since then, we have taken the initiative in every project

feedback.es: Since then va con presente perfecto: have taken, porque el efecto llega hasta hoy.

prompt.es: ¿Qué sugiere la última frase del candidato sobre su experiencia?

choices.text: That he regrets having abandoned his original plan too early.
That the failure of the first plan pushed him towards a better solution.
That he believes every failing project deserves a completely new plan.
That he enjoyed the garden more than the people who worked in it.

feedback.es: «Dudo que hubiera hecho nada de eso si el primer plan hubiera funcionado» implica que el fracaso lo empujó a escuchar y a rediseñar mejor.

origin.text: We lost our best volunteers, and the garden was close to failing. I called a meeting, listened for two hours and changed the rota twice. The garden has produced vegetables every summer since then. Honestly, I doubt that I would have done any of it if the first plan had worked.

prompt.es: Completa: «Logré darle la vuelta al proyecto escuchando antes de dar órdenes.»

feedback.es: Turn around significa reconducir algo que iba mal; turn round es la variante británica.

origin.text: Two years ago the project was failing, but I managed to turn it ___ by listening before I gave any orders.
